::: {.callout-note}
**This step is optional.** Use it when you need to extract zonal
statistics from raster data (e.g. satellite imagery, gridded
population) before building your metadata Excel in Step 3. It is
**not** sourced by `00-master.R` -- run it manually as needed.

Add `02b-...qmd`, `02c-...qmd`, etc. for additional zonal-stats
extractions.
:::

## What this step produces

This step extracts indicator values from raster data and writes a
tabular file (CSV or Excel) with one row per polygon and one column per
indicator. That file is then merged into your metadata workbook by
`pti_patch_admin_sheet()` in Step 3 -- you never manually copy data
into the Excel.

Files produced here are **inputs**, not outputs: save them into
`sample-data/`, not `app-data/`.

::: {.callout-important}
## Required output format — feed into Step 3

Your zonal stats output must be a data frame with:

| Column | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `admin2Pcod` | ✔ | Must match Pcod values in `app-data/shapes.rds` |
| `my_indicator_1` | ✔ | Column name = `var_code` in your metadata sheet |
| `my_indicator_2` | ✔ | One column per indicator |

- One row per polygon at the admin level you extracted stats for
- No geometry column — plain tabular data
- Save as CSV or `.xlsx` into `sample-data/`
- Step 3 will merge this into your metadata workbook automatically
:::

## When you need zonal stats

Typical use cases:

- Population-weighted averages of poverty rasters by district.
- Mean night-time-lights intensity per province.
- Average accessibility / travel-time per polygon.

## Common tools

- [`exactextractr`](https://isciences.gitlab.io/exactextractr/) -- fast
  zonal stats with fractional pixel coverage.
- [`terra::extract()`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/extract.html)
  -- general-purpose raster sampling.

## Code skeleton

Replace the paths and column names below with your own raster and
indicator definitions. The output file name should be descriptive
(admin level + indicator group).

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

adm2 <- sf::read_sf("sample-data/rwa_adm2.geojson")
r    <- terra::rast("path/to/your-raster.tif")

zonal_stats <- adm2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(my_indicator_1 = exactextractr::exact_extract(r, adm2, fun = "mean")) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    admin2Pcod    = shapeID,         # must match shapes.rds Pcod column
    my_indicator_1 = my_indicator_1  # var_code from your metadata sheet
  )

# Save to sample-data/ — Step 3 will read and merge this file.
writexl::write_xlsx(zonal_stats, "sample-data/zonal-stats-adm2.xlsx")
```

## Next step

Once you have saved your output to `sample-data/`, open
`03-user-data.qmd` and point `pti_patch_admin_sheet()` at your file to
merge the new indicator columns into the metadata workbook.
